scope.summary: Bind vector commands to the shared StudioHistoryEntry surface (14.19) so each discrete vector command — geometry edit, boolean/geometry operation, expand, flatten, appearance change, bulk recolor, generative result — records exactly one individually undoable/redoable history entry, and destructive commands (expand, flatten, knife) are undoable to restore the pre-command live construct; the vector domain MUST NOT batch unrelated edits into one entry in a way that prevents targeted undo.
acceptance_criteria: one undoable/redoable history entry per vector command; destructive commands restore live construct; no unrelated batching
expected_tests: live: each vector command = one StudioHistoryEntry undoable/redoable; expand/flatten/knife undo restores pre-command live construct; unrelated edits not batched (targeted undo works)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Vector edits not cleanly undoable; destructive ops irreversible; batched entries block targeted undo.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
